description: Store the user's onboarding answers as non-sensitive tags only: project_types, platforms, budget (free|under_20|any), preferences (nocode|code|open-source|free-tier), and tools_in_use (catalog ids). Unknown values are dropped — never send names, emails, code, project names or free text. Used by check_updates; when the new (canary) matcher is on, the platforms and preferences tags can also reorder equally-matched recommend_tools results by up to 2 points (tie-break only, never overriding a verified-capability filter). project_types, budget and tools_in_use never affect recommend_tools. Optional key: pass a feed key (from subscribe; send it in the Authorization: Bearer <key> header — the /api/mcp?k=KEY URL form is deprecated but still works during the transition) to keep this profile separate per project; without it, the anonymous client identity is used.

tools_in_use.description: Catalog ids of tools already in use
